name: Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery
source: Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery is a fun adult visual novel filled with romance and adventure. You play as Thomas Middleton, a first year student, who tries to get by while encountering a diverse set of wacky and fascinating characters along the way!
translation: 《橡木学院：魔法与巫术》是一部充满恋爱与冒险的成人视觉小说。你将扮演一年级学生托马斯·米德尔顿，在校园中努力生活，同时遇见形形色色古怪又迷人的角色！
